title: Lethlor Ravine

[[File:Lethlor Ravine.jpg|thumb|300px|Lethlor Ravine.]]

'''Lethlor Ravine''' is a wide craggy valley located in the eastern section of the [[Badlands]]. It is populated with [[dragon whelp]]s and [[drake]]s from the [[black dragonflight]], and contains several crystalline obelisks that are part of a [[Broken Alliances (2)|quest chain]].
